name: Single FMU Runner
description: Runs a single FMU (Functional Mock-up Unit) as configured in the static inputs

inputs.label: fmu_file_path
inputs.description: Path to the FMU file, overriding the fmu_directory from the configuration file. If empty, the path from the configuration file metadata is used.

inputs.label: fmu_parameter_dict
inputs.description: List of the input parameters of the FMU e.g. {"x": 0, "y": 1 }.

inputs.label: fmu_input_list
inputs.description: List of the input variables of the FMU e.g. ["x", "y"] or with start values {"x": 0, "y": 1 }.

inputs.label: fmu_output_list
inputs.description: List of the output variables of the FMU e.g. ["a", "b"].

inputs.label: fmu_step_size
inputs.description: Duration of each FMU time step in minutes

inputs.label: fmu_output_interval
inputs.description: Output sampling interval in minutes. Must be <= fmu_step_size. Defaults to fmu_step_size if not set. Smaller values produce more output rows per PROOF step.

inputs.label: license_file_name
inputs.description: License file necessary to run the FMU. Must be provided directly or via config file.

inputs.label: fmu_input_values
inputs.description: Schedule of input values. Flat list for single-input FMUs, list of lists for multi-input. FMI 3.0 array values are space-separated. One entry per setpoint_step_size interval. Optional.

outputs.label: fmu_output_json
outputs.description: Simulation results as a JSON string

outputs.label: fmu_output_csv
outputs.description: Simulation results as a CSV string
